1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000020_GULOOLJAJA
1.description: When I learned my daughter's champion was back in the city, I couldn't resist the opportunity.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000030_GULOOLJAJA
2.description: And they call me Head of Resolve for good reason─old as I am, I have not lost a battle worthy of the name since the day I took the throne.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000040_GULOOLJAJA
3.description: And I've been craving a proper challenge. The lance-wielder, Estinien, he fought well enough...but our bout was ended before a victor could be decided.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000050_GULOOLJAJA
4.description: Judging by the sailors' gossip, you are a warrior of renown in your homeland.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000060_GULOOLJAJA
5.description: Yet I wonder─with all your deeds done and victories won...

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000070_GULOOLJAJA
6.description: Are you warrior enough to stand against me?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
9.description: So long as neither of us gets too carried away.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
10.description: I'm not interested in fighting you...

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000090_GULOOLJAJA
12.description: A spirited answer! Why not, indeed!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000110_GULOOLJAJA
14.description: Not even the slightest hint of fear... I knew you were no pretender.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000130_GULOOLJAJA
16.description: Do you think me unworthy? I'll soon change your mind!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000140_GULOOLJAJA
17.description: The battle rage is upon me! I'll stop short of killing you, of course...but expect no other mercies!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000150_GULOOLJAJA
18.description: Come! Ready your arms and show me the truth of the tales!

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000160_GULOOLJAJA
19.description: I've brought my full strength to bear against opponents before, but you are the first to withstand it.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000170_GULOOLJAJA
20.description: Even with my Head of Reason asleep, I never expected you to give me so much trouble...

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000180_GULOOLJAJA
21.description: Estinien did not exaggerate: you are a force to be reckoned with!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000200_GULOOLJAJA
23.description: Now, a confession. I said I craved a challenge, and that was no lie...but I had another reason for calling you here.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000210_GULOOLJAJA
24.description: I had to judge for myself if you were fit to attend my beloved daughter.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000220_GULOOLJAJA
25.description: In some respects, she is much like me: hot-headed and prone to rush into danger.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000230_GULOOLJAJA
26.description: But one with your adamant defense could shield Lamaty'i from those who would do her harm.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000240_GULOOLJAJA
27.description: But one with your talents could readily dispatch the threats that bar Lamaty'i's way.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000250_GULOOLJAJA
28.description: But one with your healing touch could sustain Lamaty'i even as she contends with the most fearsome of foes.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000260_GULOOLJAJA
29.description: Will you hear my question and answer me plainly? Address me not as the ruler of Tuliyollal, but a concerned father.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000280_GULOOLJAJA
31.description: Then tell me, given your journey together thus far, what is your impression of Lamaty'i?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000290_GULOOLJAJA
32.description: Whether it be as Third Promise, or just a companion on the road. Speak your mind.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
34.description: She is young, but has potential.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
35.description: She is not ready to rule.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000310_GULOOLJAJA
37.description: A tactful response. But agreed: she is not ready for the throne. Not yet.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000330_GULOOLJAJA
39.description: Well, I did ask you to speak your mind. But agreed: she is not ready for the throne. Not yet.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000340_GULOOLJAJA
40.description: Lamaty'i thinks she understands our many peoples─their histories, their cultures, their beliefs. But she knows only what she's seen in the capital.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000350_GULOOLJAJA
41.description: And it's not only her who concerns me. Even this early in the contest, you must have realized...

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000360_GULOOLJAJA
42.description: As potential rulers, all four claimants are lacking.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000370_GULOOLJAJA
43.description: This is why I elected to hold the rite of succession─not to choose a fitting candidate, but to cultivate one.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000380_GULOOLJAJA
44.description: And if no one has impressed me by the end of it, then to no one will I yield my throne.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000390_GULOOLJAJA
45.description: As a parent, I pray that my children rise to the occasion...

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000400_GULOOLJAJA
46.description: With outsiders dragged into my game, I am also hopeful that the different perspectives you and your companions have to offer will inspire them to grow.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000410_GULOOLJAJA
47.description: I imagine you in particular have traveled many lands. Known many peoples and cultures─loved them and been loved in turn.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000420_GULOOLJAJA
48.description: Guide Lamaty'i as you think best. Walk at her side and, when needed, push her to walk ahead.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000440_WUKLAMAT
50.description: There I was, about to sit down for some of Namikka's cooking, when I heard that Papa had sent for you.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000450_WUKLAMAT
51.description: You were dueling behind my back, weren't you!

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000470_GULOOLJAJA
53.description: I see there is no point in denying it!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000480_GULOOLJAJA
54.description: You needn't worry, Daughter: I took care not to inflict lasting injuries.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000490_GULOOLJAJA
55.description: You and your ally may return to the contest without disadvantage. No harm done!

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000500_WUKLAMAT
56.description: I swear, just as I was learning newfound respect for my father...

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000510_WUKLAMAT
57.description: Let's take our leave of this battle-mad oaf before he calls on the rest of my entourage.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000530_GULOOLJAJA
59.description: Koana's recruits are no less sharp─as one might expect of Galuf's countrymen. They saw the flaws in our claimants from the outset.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000540_GULOOLJAJA
60.description: The other two, though... They dismiss comrades willing to point out their shortcomings, and no good can come of it...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000560_SAREELJA
62.description: Finding a willing artisan was even easier than expected.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000570_SAREELJA
63.description: Many indeed are eager to curry favor with the Resilient Son─especially if it means sharing the promise of new territories.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000580_ZORAALJA
64.description: Those who prove useful will have all the land they desire.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000590_SAREELJA
65.description: Such generous words, yet the manner in which he speaks them...

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000600_SAREELJA
66.description: If neither wealth nor territory are of value, wherefore does he seek to bring the world to heel...?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000620_BAKOOLJAJA
68.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Remind me... There was no rule against poaching craftsmen from other claimants, was there?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000630_SAREELJA
69.description: Do not be foolish, Bakool Ja Ja!

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000640_BAKOOLJAJA
70.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hah! Foolish would be carrying on with these dull feats when all I need to win are the keystones!

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000650_BAKOOLJAJA
71.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)And besides... It's long past time I humbled this arrogant one-head.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000660_BAKOOLJAJA
72.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)The Dawnservant may have sired you against all odds, but there is nothing blessed about your birth!

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000670_BAKOOLJAJA
73.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Only a two-head is fit to rule. Only we are worthy!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000680_BAKOOLJAJA
74.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Draw your weapon! Face me in battle and learn your place!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000700_SAREELJA
76.description: Leave him alive, if you would. I foresee a use for this...nuisance.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000710_BAKOOLJAJA
77.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Too scared to make the first move?

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000720_BAKOOLJAJA
78.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Then allow me!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000750_BAKOOLJAJA
81.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)But he... He's just a runt...

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000770_ZORAALJA
83.description: I can kill him whenever I please.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000780_SAREELJA
84.description: Your part in this is far from over.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000800_THANCRED
86.description: That Mamool Ja─he's the one who kidnapped Wuk Lamat?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000810_THANCRED
87.description: So we're still unsure. If we can follow him a bit longer─confirm his connection to the abductors...

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000850_THANCRED
91.description: If I set out now, I can trail them along the riverbank.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000870_THANCRED
93.description: Even if it costs you the contest?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000880_KOANA
94.description: What worth is the throne if I lose my sister to win it!?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000890_THANCRED
95.description: Very well, then. I'll send word when I locate her.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000900_THANCRED
96.description: Till then, I suggest you save your strength. A rescue attempt could turn ugly.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000910_KOANA
97.description: That Hoobigo just now... I swear I've seen him with Bakool Ja Ja.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000920_KOANA
98.description: Knowing the way that monster works, he probably hired bandits to kidnap her so he could steal her keystones.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000930_KOANA
99.description: But even alone, my sister is more than a match for a gang of untrained ruffians. She must have been ambushed or deceived.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000940_KOANA
100.description: I should have been there! If those bastards have hurt her...

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
104.description: I thought you were the cool-headed one.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000950_KOANA
105.description: How can I be calm when─!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000970_KOANA
107.description: And what exactly is that supposed to─!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000980_KOANA
108.description: ...Forgive me. Snapping at you won't get my sister back.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_000990_KOANA
109.description: I'm afraid I've always been like this when it comes to Lamaty'i. The thought of her being in danger sends me into a panic...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001000_KOANA
110.description: But isn't that how families <hex:021A020203>should<hex:021A020103> be?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001010_KOANA
111.description: These days, Turali Miqo'te live however they please, but the clan into which I was born kept to the nomadic traditions of our ancestors.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001015_KOANA
112.description: They herded their rroneek across the plains, always moving with the seasons...

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001020_KOANA
113.description: During one such migration, my birth parents left me behind. A child, all alone. Without a <hex:021A020203>single word<hex:021A020103> of explanation!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001030_KOANA
114.description: A chance encounter with a kind Pelu merchant was the only reason I survived. Taking pity on me, he taught me his trade that I might fend for myself.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001040_KOANA
115.description: I became a stallkeeper in Tuliyollal's markets, and that is where the Dawnservant found and adopted me.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001050_KOANA
116.description: I had already been in the palace some time when Lamaty'i came to join us.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001060_KOANA
117.description: Like me, she had been cast aside by her parents. I knew the pain of solitude, and wanted to spare her that suffering.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001070_KOANA
118.description: As this tiny child's new brother, I swore: I would always be there for her.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001080_KOANA
119.description: ...So, as you might now understand, I will stop at nothing to rescue her.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001090_KOANA
120.description: While we await word from Thancred, I suggest we prepare ourselves to travel downriver. You have a boat, yes...?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001100_KOANA
121.description: Why release the punutiy if not to delay pursuit? If we were unsure of their guilt before, then this surely proves it.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001110_KOANA
122.description: Before we act, however, let us regroup with your comrades. Would you mind making the call?

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001120_ALPHINAUD
123.description: (-Alphinaud-)Understood. We'll meet you at Many Fires.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001140_THANCRED
125.description: The Third Promise is up ahead. She's unharmed, but we'd best not dally.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001160_BAKOOLJAJA
127.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I spit on these pathetic feats─far more satisfying to claim the baubles by force!

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001170_WUKLAMAT
128.description: Give it back! Fonjeantaine poured his everything into that stone! You've no right to touch it!

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001180_BAKOOLJAJA
129.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Aw, was that the name of your artisan? How could you allow something so precious to be stolen!?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001190_WUKLAMAT
130.description: You thieving cheat! You're no true claimant!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001200_BAKOOLJAJA
131.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)What does that make the foolish kitty who fell into my trap? If pitiful roars were all it took to claim the throne, you'd be first in line!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001210_BAKOOLJAJA
132.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Now, now, Brother, you shouldn't tease her. Look, the poor thing's on the verge of tears.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001220_BAKOOLJAJA
133.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Meow! Someone save me!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001250_BAKOOLJAJA
137.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Who did that!?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001260_KOANA
138.description: Hmph, his scales are as thick as his skulls.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001270_BAKOOLJAJA
139.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Coward! You dare ambush me!?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001290_BAKOOLJAJA
141.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That useless Boonewa sycophant. He was supposed to keep the lackeys running in circles!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001300_KOANA
142.description: Oh, you must tell me all about that.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001310_BAKOOLJAJA
143.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Careful now! You wouldn't want to hit our hostage!

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001320_BAKOOLJAJA
144.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)That one's not to be underestimated!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001330_BAKOOLJAJA
145.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)They can do nothing while we have─

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001390_BAKOOLJAJA
151.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)These weaklings think they can defy us! We'll slaughter the lot of them!

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001400_BAKOOLJAJA
152.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Patience, Brother! The keystone is ours─there is no need to fight this day! And Zoraal Ja has left us hurting...

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001410_BAKOOLJAJA
153.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)No! I won't stop until I gut these maggots and feed them their entrails!

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001420_BAKOOLJAJA
154.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)If we fall here, we fail our siblings for nothing. Is that what you want?

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001450_BAKOOLJAJA
157.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Break off! We retreat!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001460_WUKLAMAT
158.description: Wait! Damn you, Bakool Ja Ja!

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001480_KOANA
160.description: We head back. Lamaty'i is safe, and that is what matters.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001490_WUKLAMAT
162.description: Gods, that is one tall mountain. And we're supposed to climb it?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001500_VORPORLOR
163.description: [Do not expect to walk here unchallenged. Tell me, stunted ones, did those short legs bring you all the way from Tuliyollal?]

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001510_ERENVILLE
164.description: He's speaking the old Yok Huy tongue. The words are...difficult to catch.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001520_VORPORLOR
165.description: Though your words are crude and cumbersome, I use them for your benefit.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001530_VORPORLOR
166.description: You are a claimant in this “rite of succession”?

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001550_VORPORLOR
168.description: Then if you die, Tuliyollal loses a potential ruler.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001560_WUKLAMAT
169.description: That's a dark thing to say, friend. I get the feeling you don't share the opinions of the other Yok Huy we've met.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001570_VORPORLOR
170.description: We do not grovel before Gulool Ja Ja like those shameless lapdogs.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001580_VORPORLOR
171.description: My brethren and I are conquerors, and we will restore our people to their rightful place as Tural's overlords!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001590_ALPHINAUD
172.description: The giants have their own factions, too, it seems...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001600_WUKLAMAT
173.description: You think your kin weak for showing deference to my father, but they do not follow the man.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001610_WUKLAMAT
174.description: It is his peace they respect. A peace they always wanted─which they realized could be had right here.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001620_VORPORLOR
175.description: Justifications of the craven! They turn their gaze from our ancestors─from the dream we kept alive for a thousand years and more!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001630_VORPORLOR
176.description: They are unworthy of bearing our legacy. <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> will reclaim the glory of our people.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001635_VORPORLOR
177.description: And our ascension begins with the death of the Third Promise!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001640_WUKLAMAT
178.description: Stop! I don't want to fight you!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001660_VORPORLOR
180.description: Opportunistic vermin! Seek to feast on us, do you!?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001670_VORPORLOR
181.description: Get down here! Your neck will be the first I snap this day!

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001710_WUKLAMAT
185.description: I didn't put much thought into it. My legs were moving before I knew what was happening.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001720_WUKLAMAT
186.description: I suppose I feared you'd die before we had the chance to get to know each other. Before I could learn more about you.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001750_WUKLAMAT
189.description: If we're to share the land, it's the best way for us to become friends.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001770_ALPHINAUD
191.description: He'll live. Not quite ready to walk under his own strength, however.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001780_WUKLAMAT
192.description: If you could stay and tend to him, the rest of us will continue on to Worqor Zormor.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001800_VORPORLOR
194.description: This changes nothing. We will not forsake our conquest.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001810_WUKLAMAT
195.description: As you like. You want to kill me, you're welcome to try. But right now, you might want to worry about your comrade.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001820_ERENVILLE
196.description: On a mountain of that size, there are bound to be creatures even I've never heard of. I'll trust you to lead the way.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001830_WUKLAMAT
197.description: Then we climb! Gurfurlur is waiting!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001840_GURFURLUR
198.description: I am Gurfurlur, elector of the Dawnservant! Prepare to be tested!

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001850_GURFURLUR
199.description: Very good, claimant. Once more, I name myself Gurfurlur. High Luminary to my people and chosen elector of the Dawnservant.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001860_WUKLAMAT
200.description: You're much bigger than the others in the village!

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001870_GURFURLUR
201.description: All Yok Huy were once my equal in size. But ever since we were decimated by disease, it is rare to see a child reach our former stature.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001880_ERENVILLE
202.description: You speak of the contagion which afflicted the Xak Tural expedition. The one recorded in your murals...

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001885_GURFURLUR
203.description: It is a chapter of our history that is entangled with the legend of the golden city.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001890_KRILE
204.description: I've heard that legend originated with the Yok Huy. Is this true...?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001900_GURFURLUR
205.description: With the visions our ancestors had, to be precise.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001910_GURFURLUR
206.description: Preceding the campaign into Xak Tural, many were visited by dreams of glittering splendor.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001920_GURFURLUR
207.description: They described a paradise that knew neither war nor famine. Where people lived lives of eternal happiness...

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001930_GURFURLUR
208.description: A single dreamer might have been dismissed. But when dozens, if not hundreds, spoke the same, the luminaries became convinced it was divine revelation.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001950_GURFURLUR
210.description: Its purpose was to find the city of gold, yes. Help was marshaled from all the territories under our control. Lands were scoured on a massive scale.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001960_ERENVILLE
211.description: Ah...little wonder the legend is so similar across Tural. Those involved with the search would've passed the stories down to their children.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001970_GURFURLUR
212.description: Another claimant, I see. I will test your worth, as I have tested those who came before you.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001980_THANCRED
213.description: “Here and now,” I think he means.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_001990_GURFURLUR
214.description: Well fought, Second Promise. For you and your sister's success in performing the Feat of Proof, you both shall be rewarded.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002010_URIANGER
216.description: How glorious it would have been to race thee and thine to the summit...though mayhap not whilst being hounded by Bakool Ja Ja and his minions.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002020_WUKLAMAT
217.description: Again that swine shows his disdain for the rite!

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002030_KOANA
218.description: Strangely, despite his eagerness to antagonize us, he withdrew as soon as we fought back in earnest. I cannot fathom what he was trying to achieve...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002040_KOANA
219.description: On a similar note, I'm also curious as to why you chose the peak of Worqor Zormor for the conclusion of this feat.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002050_KOANA
220.description: The earlier stages saw us learn the history of the Yok Huy. Does this location also hold some special meaning for your people?

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002060_GURFURLUR
221.description: Yes. It is a place of great significance.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002070_ALISAIE
222.description: All these monuments... Is this a burial ground?

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002080_GURFURLUR
223.description: Every High Luminary before me is enshrined in this earth. Alongside them are the heroes who bravely stood their ground when Valigarmanda brought ruin to Urqopacha eight decades past.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002090_ZORAALJA
224.description: Hmm... That explains why there are so many.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002100_WUKLAMAT
225.description: Zoraal Ja. I should've known you'd arrive here first...

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002120_SAREELJA
227.description: Ah, Third Promise. How relieved I am to find you in good health.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002130_WUKLAMAT
228.description: Sareel Ja, you bastard! I should end you here and now!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002140_GURFURLUR
229.description: Remember where you are. You will mind your conduct, or you will leave.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002160_ZORAALJA
231.description: I see no reason to delay further. Show me my father's sepulchre.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002180_GURFURLUR
233.description: Upon this monument are inscribed the names of those who sealed away the monstrous Valigarmanda. Your father's included.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002190_WUKLAMAT
234.description: “Gulool Ja Ja - Master of Resolve and Reason. Champion of Peace.”

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002200_ERENVILLE
235.description: Look at this one. “Ketenramm - Navigator of Uncharted Oceans.”

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002210_ALISAIE
236.description: Ketenramm? The Lominsan explorer? Does this mean he joined Gulool Ja Ja on his travels!?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002220_ERENVILLE
237.description: “Cahciua - Seeker of the Unknown.” How strange to see your name here...

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002230_GURFURLUR
238.description: It was unheard of to build living sepulchres for those who were not Yok Huy...but their great deed demanded recognition.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002240_WUKLAMAT
239.description: Master of Resolve and Reason. Champion of Peace... Papa really did some amazing things.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002250_ZORAALJA
240.description: He carved his path with martial skill.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002260_KOANA
241.description: Yet it was clever thinking which allowed him to trap Valigarmanda within its own ice magicks.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002270_WUKLAMAT
242.description: Martial skill and clever thinking... Hmm.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002280_WUKLAMAT
243.description: I can't compete with Zoraal Ja's mastery of the Head of Resolve's techniques.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002290_WUKLAMAT
244.description: And when it comes to knowledge, Koana's the one who most takes after the Head of Reason.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002300_WUKLAMAT
245.description: Is there anything that I've gotten from Papa? Something I do better than the others...

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
247.description: You have his love for peace.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
248.description: What else defines your father aside from strength and knowledge?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002340_WUKLAMAT
252.description: Papa's love for peace─for his people! That is what he's given me.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002350_WUKLAMAT
253.description: And I'm fighting to preserve the peaceful Tural he built!

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002360_WUKLAMAT
255.description: What in the hells was that!?

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002370_ALPHINAUD
256.description: (-Alphinaud-)You must return to Worlar's Echo immediately!

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002390_THANCRED
258.description: I presume that was about the unholy sound?

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002410_WUKLAMAT
260.description: We need to get back there. Now!

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002420_SAREELJA
261.description: How fortuitous. We have been gifted an opportunity to outpace our rivals.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002440_KOANA
263.description: So it's true─the ice has failed...

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002450_GURFURLUR
264.description: Zurmurwur. Tell them what you told me.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002460_ZURMURWUR
265.description: A short while ago, a claimant paid us a visit...

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002490_BAKOOLJAJA
268.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Oooh. And here we have the mighty Valigarmanda.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002500_ZURMURWUR
269.description: A terrifying vidraal. With every awakening, it has seared its ruinous name into the memories of a new generation...

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002510_BAKOOLJAJA
270.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What a good little terror.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002520_BAKOOLJAJA
271.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)You've stayed napping right up until the day I needed you!

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002540_BAKOOLJAJA
273.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)It is as they say... Gulool Ja Ja caused its magic to run rampant, trapping it in a frozen prison of its own creation. Clever, clever!

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002550_BAKOOLJAJA
274.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)To unmake it, it would be quite tricky.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002560_BAKOOLJAJA
275.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Two spells must be cast at the exact same moment: a conflagration intense enough to melt the ice, and a wakening flame to rekindle the slumbering vidraal's soul.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002570_BAKOOLJAJA
276.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The only ones capable of such harmonious execution would be the Heads of Reason and Resolve...

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002580_BAKOOLJAJA
277.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)...and the blessed siblings─Bakool Ja Ja!

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002600_BAKOOLJAJA
279.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)But I already have...

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002610_BAKOOLJAJA
280.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Rise and rage, little terror.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002620_BAKOOLJAJA
282.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I might've overdone the fire a bit.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002630_ZURMURWUR
283.description: Utter madness... Why have you done this?

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002640_BAKOOLJAJA
284.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)For the throne, of course!

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002650_ZURMURWUR
285.description: You unleash calamity for your own gain? Have you any idea how many may die!?

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002670_BAKOOLJAJA
287.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Wreak havoc, Valigarmanda. Live up to your legend.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002680_ZURMURWUR
288.description: A messenger to Tuliyollal has been dispatched. The Landsguard will send a contingent, I am sure, but there is no telling when they will arrive...

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002690_WUKLAMAT
289.description: That idiot... This monstrous act is a step too far, even for him!

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002710_WUKLAMAT
291.description: If we leave the vidraal to others, it will be a massacre.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002720_WUKLAMAT
292.description: Some might call it the wiser choice if I don't want to fall behind the competition, but I could never live with myself─and my supporters deserve a better ruler!

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002730_WUKLAMAT
293.description: So that's that. I will stay and fight Valigarmanda!

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002740_WUKLAMAT
294.description: This is an enemy so powerful that even my father failed to slay it. Alone, I don't stand a chance.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002750_WUKLAMAT
295.description: I understand you've no obligation to aid me outside the rite of succession...

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002760_WUKLAMAT
296.description: But for the sake of Urqopacha and its people, I beg you join me in this battle!

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
298.description: As if you had to ask!

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
299.description: This is the kind of challenge I live for.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
300.description: What other choice do we have...?

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002770_WUKLAMAT
301.description: Hah! Drawn to the chaos─you're as bad as Papa. Don't worry: the Skyruin should prove a big enough challenge for all of us.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002780_WUKLAMAT
302.description: You mean you'll help!? Thank you─I won't forget this!

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002790_ALISAIE
303.description: Far be it from us to abandon a dear comrade in her time of need.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002810_WUKLAMAT
305.description: Heh, I have to say, it does have a comforting ring to it.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002820_WUKLAMAT
306.description: Knowing someone has your back makes it easier to do what you have to do.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002840_KOANA
308.description: One committed to winning the contest above all else would race on ahead...

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002850_ERENVILLE
309.description: If you're resolved to slay Valigarmanda, we'll need to find out where the beast went.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002860_WUKLAMAT
310.description: That's what we have you for, old friend!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002870_GURFURLUR
311.description: Inform the Pelupelu of the danger. They may need to flee to lower ground.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002880_ERENVILLE
312.description: The trail ends here, it seems.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002890_ERENVILLE
313.description: Could Valigarmanda have shifted its elemental aspect...? It does have three to choose from, after all.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002900_ERENVILLE
314.description: In any case, I'm almost certain the vidraal was headed in the direction of Worqor Lar Dor.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002910_ERENVILLE
315.description: We should let the others know we have a likely location.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002920_ALISAIE
316.description: Alphinaud is assisting the Yok Huy with their evacuation. He thought they could use a healing hand with the injured.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002940_ERENVILLE
318.description: Worqor Lar Dor. Its stratified layers contain a wealth of crystals, said to be the source of its many-colored glow.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002950_ERENVILLE
319.description: After eighty years of imprisonment, the vidraal will be in dire need of sustenance. It would've been drawn to the mountain's energies.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002960_KRILE
320.description: So Valigarmanda seeks to replenish its aether...

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002970_WUKLAMAT
321.description: Then we'd better not give it the chance.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_002990_VORPORLOR
323.description: That mountain is sacred ground. I forbid you to set foot on it.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003000_WUKLAMAT
324.description: Sorry, we... It is not our intention to trespass.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003010_WUKLAMAT
325.description: But you must understand. That's where Valigarmanda has gone!

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003020_WUKLAMAT
326.description: If we don't slay it now, it will slaughter countless innocents─just like in the old days. I beg you, permit us to enter!

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003040_VORPORLOR
328.description: Your band is incapable of defeating Valigarmanda. Either you seek to defile Worqor Lar Dor, or you are fools.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003050_KOANA
329.description: (-Koana-)If you doubt their chances, how would you feel were we to join them?

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003060_KOANA
330.description: The monument to Valigarmanda's defeat bears the names of seven heroes. With our forces combined, we also number seven.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003070_VORPORLOR
331.description: Seven weaklings are no less doomed than four.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003080_WUKLAMAT
332.description: Zoraal Ja! You've come to help as well!

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003090_SAREELJA
333.description: Against my sound advice. While the rest of you were tussling with the Skyruin, we might have secured an insurmountable lead.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003100_ZORAALJA
334.description: A minor delay. It will not change the contest's outcome.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003110_ZORAALJA
335.description: I would take the measure of this tural vidraal my father was unable to kill.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003120_WUKLAMAT
336.description: With both my brothers here, this battle is all but won!

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003130_VORPORLOR
337.description: Your celebration is premature. I never said I would let you pass.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003140_WUKLAMAT
338.description: Brother, no! We do not bear arms against our own people!

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003150_SAREELJA
339.description: What an odd thing to say. As I recall, the inhabitants of Chirwagur Saltern do not consider themselves members of the Tuliyollal nation.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003160_SAREELJA
340.description: I'd hardly call them “our own people.”

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003170_WUKLAMAT
341.description: What does that matter!? Members or not, everyone in Tural is part of our dream for peace!

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003180_WUKLAMAT
342.description: If you would hurt them, then you'll have to go through me!

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003190_YOKHUYENEMYA
343.description: She...she saved me. From the mountain bird. Now, then...the same eyes. Eyes of stone. Words of stone.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003200_VORPORLOR
344.description: We are still in her debt. This is true.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003220_VORPORLOR
346.description: But do not misunderstand. We do not submit to Tuliyollan rule.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003230_WUKLAMAT
347.description: Aye, you've made your point. We can talk more once the contest is over!

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003250_WUKLAMAT
349.description: Wuk Lamat! Protector of peace and soon-to-be Dawnservant!

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003260_ALISAIE
350.description: Even people with wildly different ideals can find understanding through earnest discussion. I believe that wholeheartedly.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003270_WUKLAMAT
351.description: As do I. I won't give up until we reach a compromise.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003280_SAREELJA
352.description: Assuming you survive. My old bones and I will be waiting here for the true heir's return.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003290_KOANA
353.description: Your thoughts have always been a mystery to me, Brother, but I'm relieved to see you put aside the contest for the sake of the greater good.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003300_ZORAALJA
354.description: Our nation is a fortress, and its people the bricks with which it is built. The more that are lost or broken, the weaker Tuliyollal becomes.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003310_ZORAALJA
355.description: Even the crudest rock has value as a stepping stone.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003320_WUKLAMAT
356.description: Come on, you two! Forget about the rite of succession for now, and help me fight this overgrown snake-bird!

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003330_WUKLAMAT
357.description: I don't care how strong the Skyruin may be─we're going to put this menace down for good!

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003340_WUKLAMAT
358.description: We did it... We slew Valigarmanda!

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003350_WUKLAMAT
359.description: A feat that even the great Gulool Ja Ja couldn't manage!

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003370_KOANA
361.description: There's no denying it was an impressive achievement. But I wouldn't be so quick to claim we've outdone Father.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003380_KOANA
362.description: The vidraal was weakened by decades of imprisonment. Had we faced it in its prime, we wouldn't have fared a fraction as well.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003390_WUKLAMAT
363.description: How can you say that!? Eighty years couldn't have made <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> much of a difference, could it?

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003400_WUKLAMAT
364.description: Oh, who am I kidding. Papa's still the best...

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
367.description: I'm sure you'll surpass him one day.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A6_000_003_NONE_VOICE
368.description: You have a ways to go...

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003410_WUKLAMAT
369.description: I did, didn't I? Even if it wasn't at full strength, we defeated a living legend!

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003420_WUKLAMAT
370.description: I swear, I'll surpass the old man one day!

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003430_WUKLAMAT
371.description: You're right about that! Just need a few more battles like this one under my belt!

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003440_WUKLAMAT
372.description: You're right about that... I'll need to improve if I want to surpass the old man.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003450_ZORAALJA
373.description: The Skyruin lies dead, and still I have yet to prove myself the miracle...

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003460_KRILE
374.description: Well, I suppose we should head back and join Erenville.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003470_WUKLAMAT
375.description: Aye, we did leave him with only Sareel Ja for company...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003490_GURFURLUR
377.description: (-???-)That won't be necessary, heroes of the hour.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003500_GURFURLUR
378.description: Valigarmanda is no more. Yours is a victory worthy of song.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003510_ZURMURWUR
379.description: Hmm... We had plans for a second feat to be conducted here in town, but the recklessness of your fellow claimant has rendered them pointless.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003530_ZURMURWUR
381.description: The Feat of Ice. You were to fortify Valigarmanda's prison.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003540_ZURMURWUR
382.description: Hmm... How shall we proceed, High Luminary?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003550_GURFURLUR
383.description: What more would we test, Zurmurwur? They have defeated the Skyruin and saved the gods know how many lives. If they are not worthy heirs to Gulool Ja Ja, then no one is.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003560_GURFURLUR
384.description: Now that our last claimant has arrived, we can proceed with the formalities. For the skill and bravery the three of you have shown, I award you each a second keystone.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003570_ALPHINAUD
385.description: That makes five. Only two left to collect.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003580_WUKLAMAT
386.description: Except that one of those five is in Bakool Ja Ja's thieving hands. He will answer for that─and for loosing Valigarmanda!

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003590_GURFURLUR
387.description: You have brought lasting tranquility to our home, and earned the gratitude of every Yok Huy.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003600_GURFURLUR
388.description: May glory and prosperity continue to bless Tuliyollal as we enter this new age!

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003610_WUKLAMAT
389.description: Was never much of a talker, our brother.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003620_WUKLAMAT
390.description: If you're up for it, you should visit the capital! I'd like everyone to get to know you and your people better!

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003630_GURFURLUR
391.description: Hah! I'll consider it...if it's one of you two who claims the throne.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003640_KOANA
392.description: Then you need only await a missive from Sunperch─I'll be sending out invitations.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003650_GURFURLUR
393.description: Today is a day for unusual visitors.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003660_VORPORLOR
394.description: You... Wuk Lamat, was it not?

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003670_VORPORLOR
395.description: I doubted you could slay Valigarmanda, but the quiet skies proclaim your triumph.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003680_VORPORLOR
396.description: Had the vidraal been suffered to roam free, it would have terrorized us all... Once again, we find ourselves in your debt.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003690_WUKLAMAT
397.description: You owe us nothing─we fought because we wanted to.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003700_VORPORLOR
398.description: Yet a debt has been incurred all the same. It will haunt me if I do not repay it.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003710_WUKLAMAT
399.description: Hrmmm... I wouldn't even know what to ask for.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003720_KRILE
400.description: Perhaps he can tell us about the dreams of the golden city?

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003730_WUKLAMAT
401.description: Oh, good idea! That was on my list of questions I wanted to ask!

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003740_VORPORLOR
402.description: The golden dreams... Yes, we have records of our forebears and their visions from the time before the Xak Tural expedition.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003760_VORPORLOR
404.description: A heavenly land, suffused with a golden glow. Its people lived as gods, never aging, never dying, free from hardship and conflict.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003770_VORPORLOR
405.description: Every building was a palace, and in their midst reigned a silent goddess. A statue so tall even my kin would need lift their gaze to behold its visage.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003780_KRILE
406.description: A statue of a goddess? That's new...

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003790_ALPHINAUD
407.description: Aye. And compared to the abstract imagery we'd previously heard, this was a detailed description.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003800_VORPORLOR
408.description: The dreamers were consumed by their visions─compelled to seek out the paradise they'd been shown. They journeyed to Xak Tural...where they died in droves.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003810_KRILE
409.description: Those who go in search of the golden city do not return... The tales Wuk Evu shared may have been rooted in historical fact.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003820_VORPORLOR
410.description: Perhaps. Who can know the truth of it? Once our ancestors left the forest, there were no more dreams nor dreamers.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003830_KRILE
411.description: The forest? What do you mean?

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003840_VORPORLOR
412.description: From the very first, the visions were said to visit only those who worked the quarries in Yak T'el.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003850_VORPORLOR
413.description: But after they were ravaged by disease and saw fewer newborns, they were forced to abandon that territory.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003860_VORPORLOR
414.description: Once our people's withdrawal to Urqopacha was complete, we never again dreamed of the golden city.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003870_KRILE
415.description: So only Yok Huy in that one specific area experienced the visions... Fascinating.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003880_WUKLAMAT
416.description: Well, we're headed to Yak T'el next. Maybe we'll find out more when we get there.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003890_WUKLAMAT
417.description: Thank you for sharing your stories with us.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003900_VORPORLOR
418.description: I do not require gratitude. I merely repaid a debt.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003910_VORPORLOR
419.description: Farewell, Wuk Lamat. I do not think our paths will cross again.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003930_WUKLAMAT
421.description: There's something I wanted to talk to you about...

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003960_WUKLAMAT
424.description: It's just too...stuffy in here, that's what.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003970_WUKLAMAT
425.description: We should go outside! Aye, a nice walk in the fresh air─that's what we need!

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_003990_WUKLAMAT
427.description: I used to come here all the time when I was little. I would look out over the whole city, and whatever worries I had would seem so small.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004000_WUKLAMAT
428.description: Do you remember what I said at the top of Worqor Zormor...?

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004010_WUKLAMAT
429.description: That I would fight to preserve Papa's peaceful Tural?

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004020_WUKLAMAT
430.description: Well, I've been thinking a lot since then.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004030_WUKLAMAT
431.description: About what “peace” really means. If it's just...the absence of war.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004040_WUKLAMAT
432.description: And it brought to mind all the best parts of our journey so far.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004050_WUKLAMAT
433.description: I realized: nothing gives me greater joy than the happiness of others.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004060_WUKLAMAT
434.description: Life has its ups and downs, but the company of family and friends, and the music of their laughter is what makes it worth living.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004070_WUKLAMAT
435.description: And as silly as it might sound, I've come to believe that those smiling faces are the best measure of peace.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
437.description: That's the sort of thing I'd expect you to say.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
438.description: You wish for a world like in the Yok Huy's dream?

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004080_WUKLAMAT
440.description: Heh, really? I feel proud somehow.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004090_WUKLAMAT
441.description: It's an answer I arrived at by trying to be true to myself. That you think I succeeded... It means a lot.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004100_WUKLAMAT
442.description: With eternal life and no struggle or conflict? It's certainly an ideal worth striving for.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004110_WUKLAMAT
443.description: Who knows if we could make such a world a reality─but renouncing war and conquest seems like a good place to start.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004120_WUKLAMAT
444.description: I understand that making everyone happy isn't practical or even possible.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004130_WUKLAMAT
445.description: But that doesn't mean we shouldn't try!

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004150_WUKLAMAT
447.description: When I become Dawnservant, I'll build on Papa's peace! Our people will live together in harmony!

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004170_WUKLAMAT
449.description: By taking the time to hear their concerns, understand their feelings, and consider how best to serve... With each passing day, I'll be that much closer to becoming the leader I want to be.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004180_WUKLAMAT
450.description: It's hard for me to say how much I've changed since the contest began, but there's one thing I can say with confidence.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004190_WUKLAMAT
451.description: I wouldn't have come this far without you as allies!

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004200_WUKLAMAT
452.description: If it wasn't for you all listening and feeling and thinking along with me, I would have never learned so much, and in so short a time.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004210_WUKLAMAT
453.description: There are two keystones left. After everything that's happened─and imagining what <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> happen─are you still willing to walk this path with me?

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004220_WUKLAMAT
454.description: Heh, thank the gods for that.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07001_004230_WUKLAMAT
455.description: Well, I've nothing else to get off my chest! I need to head to the palace, but I'll see you back at the cabins.
